WITH RECURSIVE
base AS (
  SELECT
    ol.order_id,
    ol.line_no,
    s.sku_code,
    ol.qty AS sold_qty,
    o.order_date
  FROM order_line ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
  JOIN store st ON st.store_id = l.store_id
  JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND st.country = 'DE'
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
expanded AS (
  SELECT
    b.order_id,
    b.line_no,
    b.sku_code AS current_code,
    b.sold_qty,
    1 AS mult,
    b.order_date
  FROM base b

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    e.order_id,
    e.line_no,
    uc.child_code AS current_code,
    e.sold_qty,
    e.mult * uc.qty AS mult,
    e.order_date
  FROM expanded e
  JOIN u_composition uc
    ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
   AND uc.parent_code = e.current_code
   AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
   AND uc.valid_from <= e.order_date
   AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM expanded e
JOIN u_composition uc
  ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
 AND uc.parent_code = e.current_code
 AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
 AND uc.valid_from <= e.order_date
 AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
JOIN company_model cm
  ON cm.model_code = uc.child_code
GROUP BY cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(e.sold_qty * e.mult * uc.qty) DESC, cm.model_code
LIMIT 3;
```

WITH RECURSIVE
order_skus AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id,
        ol.qty
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND st.store_name = 'Amazon-CA-14'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
bundle_expand(order_id, line_no, order_date, sku_id, qty) AS (
    SELECT order_id, line_no, order_date, sku_id, qty
    FROM order_skus

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        be.order_id,
        be.line_no,
        be.order_date,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        be.qty * bi.qty
    FROM bundle_expand be
    JOIN sales_sku bs ON bs.sku_id = be.sku_id AND bs.is_bundle = TRUE
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = be.sku_id
),
leaf_skus AS (
    SELECT be.order_id, be.line_no, be.order_date, be.sku_id, be.qty
    FROM bundle_expand be
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = be.sku_id
    WHERE s.is_bundle = FALSE
),
model_requirements AS (
    SELECT
        ls.order_id,
        ls.line_no,
        ls.order_date,
        sm.model_id,
        ls.qty * sm.qty AS qty
    FROM leaf_skus ls
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = ls.sku_id
),
component_expand(order_id, line_no, order_date, component_id, qty) AS (
    SELECT
        mr.order_id,
        mr.line_no,
        mr.order_date,
        mb.component_id,
        mr.qty * mb.qty
    FROM model_requirements mr
    JOIN model_bom mb
      ON mb.model_id = mr.model_id
     AND mb.valid_from <= mr.order_date
     AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mr.order_date <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ce.order_id,
        ce.line_no,
        ce.order_date,
        cb.child_component_id,
        ce.qty * cb.qty
    FROM component_expand ce
    JOIN component parent_c
      ON parent_c.component_id = ce.component_id
     AND parent_c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb
      ON cb.parent_component_id = ce.component_id
     AND cb.valid_from <= ce.order_date
     AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR ce.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ce.qty), 0) AS units
FROM component_expand ce
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = ce.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-998-OAK-02932'
  AND c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

WITH RECURSIVE
order_lines AS (
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        o.order_date,
        l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-US-00'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
sku_explosion AS (
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.sku_id,
        1::DOUBLE AS sku_qty
    FROM order_lines ol

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        se.order_id,
        se.line_no,
        se.order_date,
        se.line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        se.sku_qty * bi.qty AS sku_qty
    FROM sku_explosion se
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = se.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = se.sku_id
    WHERE sk.is_bundle = true
),
sku_models AS (
    SELECT
        se.order_id,
        se.line_no,
        se.order_date,
        se.line_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        se.sku_qty * sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sku_explosion se
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = se.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = se.sku_id
    WHERE sk.is_bundle = false
),
model_components AS (
    SELECT
        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.order_date,
        mb.component_id,
        sm.line_qty * sm.model_qty * mb.qty AS qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb
      ON mb.model_id = sm.model_id
     AND mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date
     AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),
component_explosion AS (
    SELECT
        mc.order_id,
        mc.line_no,
        mc.order_date,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.qty
    FROM model_components mc

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        ce.order_id,
        ce.line_no,
        ce.order_date,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        ce.qty * cb.qty AS qty
    FROM component_explosion ce
    JOIN component c
      ON c.component_id = ce.component_id
     AND c.is_assembly = true
    JOIN component_bom cb
      ON cb.parent_component_id = ce.component_id
     AND cb.valid_from <= ce.order_date
     AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR ce.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(ce.qty), 0) AS BIGINT) AS units
FROM component_explosion ce
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = ce.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'LEG-407-OAK-00192'
